name: Elixir of Health

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Cures disease and ends the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed and Poisoned conditions.
text: When you drink this potion, it cures any disease afflicting you, and it ends the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed and Poisoned conditions on you. The clear red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.
